events.description: Warning: rapid snowmelt/runoff and breakup on Zhabai/Kalkutan expected 3-6 Apr; levels may reach/exceed critical marks.

description_i18n.kk: Ескерту: 3–6 сәуірде Жабай/Қалқұтан өзендерінде қардың қарқынды еруі, ағын және мұз жүруі күтіледі; деңгейлер сыни белгілерге жетуі немесе асуы мүмкін.
description_i18n.ru: Предупреждение: 3–6 апреля на Жабае/Калкутане ожидаются интенсивное снеготаяние, сток и вскрытие; уровни могут достичь или превысить критические отметки.
description_i18n.en: Warning: rapid snowmelt/runoff and breakup on Zhabai/Kalkutan expected 3-6 Apr; levels may reach/exceed critical marks.

events.description: Residents of coastal zones of Ishim, Zhabai and Zhylandy warned that critical levels were expected within the next day and to prepare for evacuation.

description_i18n.kk: Есіл, Жабай және Жыланды өзендерінің жағалау аймақтарының тұрғындарына келесі тәулік ішінде сыни деңгейлер күтілетіні және эвакуацияға дайындалу қажеттігі ескертілді.
description_i18n.ru: Жители прибрежных зон Ишима, Жабая и Жыланды предупреждены, что критические уровни ожидаются в течение суток, и о необходимости готовиться к эвакуации.
description_i18n.en: Residents of coastal zones of Ishim, Zhabai and Zhylandy warned that critical levels were expected within the next day and to prepare for evacuation.

events.description: 123 people reported evacuated; 133 responders/participants, 38 equipment units and 10 motor pumps involved.

description_i18n.kk: 123 адам эвакуацияланғаны хабарланды; 133 қатысушы/құтқарушы, 38 техника бірлігі және 10 мотопомпа тартылды.
description_i18n.ru: Сообщается об эвакуации 123 человек; задействованы 133 участника, 38 единиц техники и 10 мотопомп.
description_i18n.en: 123 people reported evacuated; 133 responders/participants, 38 equipment units and 10 motor pumps involved.

events.description: Overflow occurred at six sections of the earth embankment on the Zhabai, leading to flooding in Atbasar.

description_i18n.kk: Жабайдағы топырақ бөгеттің алты учаскесінде су асып төгіліп, Атбасарда су басу болды.
description_i18n.ru: Произошёл перелив на шести участках земляной дамбы на Жабае, что привело к подтоплению Атбасара.
description_i18n.en: Overflow occurred at six sections of the earth embankment on the Zhabai, leading to flooding in Atbasar.

events.description: Evacuation and protection measures underway; more than 400 people and 100 equipment units were engaged.

description_i18n.kk: Эвакуация және қорғау шаралары жүргізілуде; 400-ден астам адам және 100 техника бірлігі тартылды.
description_i18n.ru: Ведутся эвакуация и защитные мероприятия; задействовано более 400 человек и 100 единиц техники.
description_i18n.en: Evacuation and protection measures underway; more than 400 people and 100 equipment units were engaged.

events.description: Regional report: Zhabai level decreased from 5.5 m to 5.0 m; damaged roads and flooded yards were being restored/pumped.

description_i18n.kk: Өңірлік есеп: Жабай деңгейі 5,5 м-ден 5,0 м-ге төмендеді; бүлінген жолдар қалпына келтіріліп, су басқан аулалардан су сорылуда.
description_i18n.ru: Региональная сводка: уровень Жабая снизился с 5,5 до 5,0 м; повреждённые дороги восстанавливаются, из подтопленных дворов откачивается вода.
description_i18n.en: Regional report: Zhabai level decreased from 5.5 m to 5.0 m; damaged roads and flooded yards were being restored/pumped.

events.description: Zhabai level reported at 3.80 m; regional authorities described the critical period as passed and recovery underway.

description_i18n.kk: Жабай деңгейі 3,80 м деп хабарланды; өңірлік билік сыни кезең өтті және қалпына келтіру жүріп жатыр деп мәлімдеді.
description_i18n.ru: Уровень Жабая — 3,80 м; региональные власти сообщили, что критический период пройден и идёт восстановление.
description_i18n.en: Zhabai level reported at 3.80 m; regional authorities described the critical period as passed and recovery underway.

events.description: Flood threat in Akmola reported as passed; Zhabai level reported at 2.8 m.

description_i18n.kk: Ақмола облысында су тасқыны қаупі өтті деп хабарланды; Жабай деңгейі 2,8 м.
description_i18n.ru: Угроза паводка в Акмолинской области миновала; уровень Жабая — 2,8 м.
description_i18n.en: Flood threat in Akmola reported as passed; Zhabai level reported at 2.8 m.

hydrology.notes: Reported by Atbasar flood headquarters; do not merge numerically with Kazhydromet hydropost datum unless datum equivalence is established.
Source states below 1 m; value stored as upper bound, not exact observation.
Emergency service reported critical mark 4.45 m and current level 4.50 m. Treat time as report/publication time rather than guaranteed instrument timestamp.
At 04:43 overflow occurred at six sections of the earth embankment; report says level reached 5.95 m.
Official Akmola content says level decreased from 5.5 m to 5.0 m.
Regional statement says level decreased to 3.80 m; also reports flood-event peak of 6.20 m.
Emergency service content reports level down to 2.8 m.

event_peak.notes: Retrospective statement: during the flood the Zhabai level rose to 6.20 m. Exact peak timestamp is not stated, so this must not be inserted as a timestamped gauge observation.

notes_i18n.kk: Ретроспективалық мәлімдеме: су тасқыны кезінде Жабай деңгейі 6,20 м-ге дейін көтерілді. Шыңның нақты уақыты көрсетілмеген, сондықтан бұл уақыт белгісі бар бекет бақылауы ретінде енгізілмейді.
notes_i18n.ru: Ретроспективное заявление: во время паводка уровень Жабая поднимался до 6,20 м. Точное время пика не указано, поэтому значение не вносится как наблюдение поста с отметкой времени.
notes_i18n.en: Retrospective statement: during the flood the Zhabai level rose to 6.20 m. Exact peak timestamp is not stated, so this must not be inserted as a timestamped gauge observation.

glofas.caveat: Approx. 5 km model grid; the selected river cell may not exactly represent the local river. Never overrides local official observations.

event.name: Atbasar flood 2024
event.optical_reference_strategy: Use post-recession Sentinel-2 baseline because the clear pre-flood 2024-04-04 scene is predominantly snow/ice over the AOI; compare flood-period open water against a clear post-recession scene.

satellite.source: Sentinel-2 L2A via Element84 Earth Search
satellite.reason: Optical fallback because Sentinel-1 catalogue probes returned zero acquisitions for Atbasar 2024. A post-recession optical reference is used because the clear 2024-04-04 scene is predominantly snow/ice over the AOI.
satellite.selection_rule: >=90% AOI coverage, required spectral/SCL assets, nearest target dates with cloud penalty

mask_method.source: Sentinel-2 L2A flood-vs-post-recession change detection via Element84 Earth Search
mask_method.fallback_reason: No Sentinel-1 acquisition was found for the Atbasar 2024 event window. The clear early-April optical scene is snow/ice-heavy, so a clear post-recession reference is used instead of pretending it is a valid pre-flood open-water baseline.
mask_method.method: SCL cloud/shadow/snow masking; MNDWI + NDWI open-water test; flood-minus-post-reference MNDWI change > 0.08; slope<=7 degrees; JRC >=90% permanent-water exclusion where available; morphology.
caveats: Flood water still present in the post-recession scene will be conservatively omitted.
Optical imagery can miss turbid, shallow, vegetated or cloud-obscured floodwater.
The mask evaluates only pixels usable in both selected scenes.
This is observational evidence, not a hydrodynamic model.
Visual QC is mandatory before using this mask as validation evidence.

note.kk: Ресми оқиға дерегі модель немесе Sentinel-2 ашық су маскасы қайта жасамаған қала ішіндегі әсерді бөлек көрсетеді.
note.ru: Официальные сведения о событии отдельно показывают городские последствия, которые модель и маска открытой воды Sentinel-2 не воспроизводят.
note.en: Official event evidence separately records urban impacts that the model and Sentinel-2 open-water mask do not reproduce.

description.kk: Ресми хабарламада Жабай деңгейі 5,95 м болғанда қорғаныс үйінділерінің алты учаскесінен су асқаны көрсетілген. Бұл факт модельдік су басу полигоны ретінде қолданылмайды.
description.ru: В официальном сообщении при уровне Жабая 5,95 м отмечен перелив через шесть участков защитной насыпи. Этот факт не используется как выдуманный полигон затопления.
description.en: Official reporting records Zhabai at 5.95 m and overflow across six protective-embankment sections. ARGUS does not convert this fact into an invented inundation polygon.

scenario_note: Hybrid terrain-conditioned susceptibility and stage proxy calibrated against the Sentinel-2 flood evidence of 14 Apr 2024. Not a hydrodynamic model. Time profile is a stage-proxy presentation; the peak (offset 0) is anchored to the official overflow record of 11 Apr 2024 04:43 (Zhabai 5.95 m local level). Native frames every 180 min; intermediate frames are linear interpolations.
scenario_limitations: This is a hybrid terrain/susceptibility model, not HEC-RAS/LISFLOOD-FP or a surveyed hydraulic model.
The same historical event supplies the satellite target; the alternating spatial holdout is not out-of-event validation.
The susceptibility classifier uses terrain/hydro features only and intentionally excludes raw X/Y coordinates.
DEM is a ~30 m DSM and local levees/culverts/channel bathymetry are not surveyed here.
Gauge stage and the stage proxy are related only for scenario presentation; this is not a validated stage-discharge-depth rating curve.
Observed satellite mask remains subject to manual/domain QC.

Town-interior flooding from embankment overtopping (officially recorded on 11 Apr 2024) is not reproduced: the 30 m DSM does not resolve levees/culverts and the 14 Apr optical mask shows no detectable open water in the built-up area.
